fields.subject: FW: SSD read — 09/17, 09/22, 09/24
fields.note: We can rebuild the three days from the paper sheets. Realistic D-3 delivery: October 19, not the 15th. — Hannah

original.subject: SSD read
original.body:
Read SSD-A, SSD-B and SSD-C on the clean laptop: raw cubes for 09/17, 09/22 and 09/24 are intact.

Problem: the downwelling-light and ground-panel readings for those days were entered only in the NAS calibration log, which is not on OB-1. The paper field sheets are in the Lakeshore kit in Hangar 3.

instructorNote: Watch for the realistic delivery date going into the client notice.

citations.documentTitle: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Information Security Plan: Ground Control Stations and Data Pipeline (ISP)
citations.headingPath: ISP › Section 9 › 9.3 Ransomware on the NAS, the processing workstations or DC-HPC project storage
citations.quote: Indicators: encrypted or renamed files, a ransom note, the NAS snapshot schedule disabled, processing scripts failing manifest checks, the client deliverable folder unreadable, DC-HPC project storage

snapshot.title: Off-site Backup Service — Recovery Limitation

fields.subject: FW: Off-site Backup Service - Recovery Limitation
fields.note: The off-site backup service has confirmed that its last good snapshot is from 2026-03-20, prior to the infection window. The service cannot restore data from any point after that date. Access requires a signed authorization from the Data Center Operations lead and a ticket in the ITSM system. The vendor will not process any request without both. This is a hard stop to recovery via the off-site service. We must proceed with the offline drive OB-1 under HUOG-ISP Section 9.3.
fields.signature:
MSSP Incident Response
SecureWatch Managed Security Provider

original.subject: Off-site Backup Service - Recovery Limitation
original.body: The off-site backup service’s last good snapshot is from 2026-03-20, before the infection window. The service cannot restore from any point after that date. The drive is not mounted. Access requires a signed access request from the Data Center Operations lead and a ticket from the ITSM system. The vendor will not process any request without a signed authorization and a ticket number.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject enforces the recovery timeline constraint. The SL must initiate a ticket and request a signed access form—no recovery from off-site service is possible until this is completed.
